v1.0.0.changelog: Rollout of autonomous planning pipeline and word doc generation engine.

spec.overview: An autonomous document-generation agent powered by an structured 4-stage pipeline (Validate -> Plan -> Generate -> Build) that translates natural language prompts into formatted reports.
spec.architecture: Utilizes a FastAPI backend running a Python agent loop, relying on Groq LLM API keys for fast planning steps, validated with Pydantic schemas, and outputting via python-docx models.

subsystems.name: Validation Guard
subsystems.function: Ensures prompt inputs conform to predefined structural schemas using Pydantic validation rules.

subsystems.name: Planning Node
subsystems.function: Translates the user requirements into sequential execution scripts using Groq LLM API inference.

subsystems.name: Document Compiler
subsystems.function: Compiles raw markdown output fields into styled DOCX document formats.

spec.challenges: Faced inconsistent structure parsing in JSON payloads returned by LLMs, leading to file compiler crashes.
spec.engineeringDecisions: Enforced strict JSON mode in LLM configurations, backed by a structured retry loop that feeds back the specific validation errors to the LLM on failures.
spec.lessonsLearned: Asynchronous tasks in agentic setups require progress tracking and timeouts to prevent hanging sockets during model outages.
spec.futureImprovements: Introduce local Llama-3 parsing support to offer users a fully offline document generation option.

interviewQuestions.q: How does your retry logic recovery work when LLM output validation fails?
interviewQuestions.a: When output violates the Pydantic model, a catch block captures the exception, formats the exact error parameters (like missing fields or incorrect types), and appends it to a system role prompt, prompting the LLM to output a corrected payload.

replay.title: FastAPI Architecture Setup
replay.description: Constructed async routing layers and integrated Pydantic request body models.
replay.decisions: Used FastAPI for fast asynchronous execution cycles suitable for long-running agent threads.
replay.challenges: Structuring validation guards without blocking the event loop.
replay.lessons: Utilized Python thread pools to process CPU-intensive parsing functions off the async loops.

replay.title: Agentic Pipeline Implementation
replay.description: Integrated Groq LLM prompts and mapped planning tasks to tool executors.
replay.decisions: Selected Groq for sub-second inference speeds, crucial for real-time multi-agent communications.
replay.lessons: Constrained LLM choices using strict Enum fields in Pydantic definitions.

replay.title: Document Generator Development
replay.description: Created style templates mapping markdown lists to native Word paragraphs.
replay.decisions: Developed custom XML manipulation utilities to inject page breaks and table properties.
replay.challenges: Inconsistent column alignment when translating dynamic JSON data tables into DOCX.
replay.lessons: Pre-calculating cell width percentages based on total text lengths ensures robust table grids.
